import hashlib,json,math,pathlib,subprocess,re
here=pathlib.Path('docs/baselines/v2-phase-e/final-gate')
sha=lambda path:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
summary=json.loads((here/'validation-results.json').read_text())
for check in summary['checks']:
    p=pathlib.Path(check['log']); assert sha(p)==check['log_sha256'],str(p)
    log=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert log['exit_code']==check['exit_code']==0,str(p)
    assert log['command']==check['command'],str(p)
    for field in ['python_tests','rust_test_totals']:
        if field in check: assert log[field]==check[field],(str(p),field)
    if 'stdin' in log: assert hashlib.sha256(log['stdin'].encode()).hexdigest()==log['stdin_sha256'],str(p)
print('All 12 validation-09..20 exact command/exit/log SHA256 and test counts verified.')
for name,expected in summary['generated_artifacts_sha256'].items(): assert sha(here/name)==expected,name
for name,expected in summary['frozen_harness_sha256'].items(): assert sha(here/name)==expected,name
assert summary['red_before']==json.loads((here/'invalid-validation-attempt/validation-results.json').read_text())['red_before']
print('Historical partial red-before record preserved exactly, not newly claimed.')
protocol=json.loads((here/'protocol.json').read_text()); measured=json.loads((here/'measurements.json').read_text()); proof=json.loads((here/'proof.json').read_text())
assert summary['protocol_sha256']==sha(here/'protocol.json')
assert summary['protocol_frozen_at_unix_ns']==protocol['frozen_at_unix_ns']
assert summary['measurements_started_at_unix_ns']==measured['started_at_unix_ns']
assert summary['measurements_finished_at_unix_ns']==measured['finished_at_unix_ns']
assert summary['release_approved']==proof['release_approved']==False and summary['sync_enabled']==proof['sync_enabled']==0
assert summary['bootstrap_required']==proof['bootstrap_required']==1 and summary['phase_f_deferred'] is True
names={'capture':'Capture','effective':'Effective priority','note_only':'Note-only','compound':'Compound','replay':'Receipt replay','genuine_noop':'Genuine no-op'}
report=(here/'REPORT.md').read_text(); dispositions={}; overhead=[]
for kind,label in names.items():
    cells=[]
    for fixture in measured['fixtures']:
        stats=fixture['workloads'][kind]['statistics']; lo,hi=stats['paired_ratio_ci95']
        cells.append(f"{stats['paired_median_ratio']:.3f} [{lo:.3f}, {hi:.3f}]")
        disposition=stats['disposition']; dispositions[disposition]=dispositions.get(disposition,0)+1
        if kind in ['effective','note_only','compound']: overhead.append((stats['paired_median_ratio']-1)*100)
    line='| '+label+' | '+' | '.join(cells)+' |'
    assert line in report,line
for key in ['no_trigger','explanation_review_required','inconclusive_repeat']:
    assert summary['cost_disposition'][key]==dispositions.get(key,0),key
for a,b in zip(summary['cost_disposition']['effective_note_compound_paired_overhead_percent_range'],[min(overhead),max(overhead)]): assert math.isclose(a,b,abs_tol=1e-12),(a,b)
assert protocol['frozen_at_unix_ns']<measured['started_at_unix_ns']<measured['finished_at_unix_ns']
assert proof['diagnostic']['stdout'].strip() in report
assert summary['runtime_command']==json.loads((here/'validation-09.json').read_text())['command']
print('Every report measurement cell and actual disposition recomputed against fresh measurements; freeze ordering, diagnostic and inactive flags verified.')
for command in [
    ['python3',str(here/'gate.py'),'--validate','--output',str(here)],
    ['python3',str(here/'test_gate.py')],
    ['cargo','test','--locked','--test','phase_e_upgrade_proof','--test','phase_e_schema_guards','--test','read_release_manifest','--test','phase_e_final_gate'],
]:
    print('Final command: '+' '.join(command),flush=True)
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    print(result.stdout,end='');print(result.stderr,end='');assert result.returncode==0
for n in [19,20]:
    log=json.loads((here/f'validation-{n:02d}.json').read_text())
    print('Repeat exact recorded stdin from validation-'+str(n),flush=True)
    result=subprocess.run(log['argv'],input=log['stdin'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    print(result.stdout,end='');print(result.stderr,end='');assert result.returncode==0
print('Final manifest SHA256: '+sha(here/'validation-results.json'))
print('Final report SHA256: '+sha(here/'REPORT.md'))
